The coming admission — “we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺” (37:31) — will confess consequence without escaping it. Tasting cannot be untasted by tasting-words. Mercy had its office in Makkah's markets; the plain of rising hosts justice alone. Pity the timing, not the verdict: every late confessor was an early refuser. Early refusers make late confessors; the sequence never reverses.

**Woe Answers Wonder Across the Sūrah's Arch**

Two astonishments frame the passage. In verse 12 the Prophet marveled at denial; in verse 20 denial marvels at judgment. Wonder that warned meets woe that confesses — the same Day viewed from opposite sides of faith. Symmetry preaches. Every marvel at truth refused becomes, in time, a wail at truth revealed; amazement migrates from the righteous to the ruined. The Prophet's *ʿajab* hoped to prevent this *wayl*; rejection of the first guaranteed the second.
verses.21:
> ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision which you used to deny.”

**Heaven Answers the Wail With a Title**

Lament gets its reply at last. The deniers named the Day through tears — “This is the Day of Judgment!” (37:20) — and heaven answers with a title of its own. *They will be told*: the passive veils the speaker in majesty, as though the whole court intoned the words at once. No angel is named, no herald introduced; the voice heard is authority's own. Reply completes the dialogue that verse 20 began: man's cry first, then God's caption. Symmetry like this sobers every reader who traces it. Every human word on that Day receives its heavier divine counterpart, and wailing earns its naming. The told cannot untell what the court has pronounced over them. Titles spoken from the bench adhere to prisoners forever. What follows the telling is the title itself — Decision, final, denied too long. Wailing asked for pity; naming answers with precision instead. Precision wounds deeper than pity could ever heal.

**Decision Means Division, Not Mere Verdict**

*Yawm al-faṣl* — the Day of Decision, of Division, of Sorting out. *Faṣl* cuts: truth from falsehood, believer from denier, garden-bound from fire-bound. Verdicts declare, but divisions separate — and this Day does both together. It judges first, then parts the judged into companies that never remix. Other passages name the same Day Decision and press hearers to grasp its weight (77:13–14). Appointment defines it: the Day was dated before any denier doubted it (78:17). Division also answers the crowd's false unity in error. Together they mocked, but decision scatters them into kinds forever. Each soul gets filed exactly where its deeds already filed it. Cutting is final by nature; what decision severs, eternity never sutures. Separation completes what sentencing begins. The Day decides, divides, and dismisses — in that order, without appeal. No reunion follows this parting. Eternity keeps the sorted order.

**Which You Used to Deny Closes Every Excuse**

*Alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhdhibūn* — which you used to deny, again and again. *Kāna* with the imperfect stretches denial across a lifetime of mornings. This was no slip of the tongue but a renewed daily policy. The charge specifies the crime with prosecutorial precision. They denied this Day — its coming, its court, its consequences. Documentation stands complete: reminders delivered, messengers dispatched, signs displayed. *You* personalizes the indictment beyond escape. No tribe absorbs the blame, and no leader carries it away. *We never knew* dies where *you were told* lives on.

**Two Titles for One Day: Judgment and Decision**

Verse 20 cried *Judgment*; verse 21 answers *Decision*. *Dīn* stresses requital: debts paid in full, wages rendered exactly. *Faṣl* stresses separation: kinds parted, ranks divided forever. Together the titles complete the Day from both sides. First comes what gets settled, then who gets sundered. The denied content behind both titles was always one question — “will we really be resurrected?” (37:16). Arrival has now answered what argument could not. Titles multiply because the Day overflows every single name. The Book elsewhere adds still others, each catching another facet. Plenitude of names signals magnitude in the thing Named. One Day, many titles, no escape for anyone. Judgment pays every wage, Decision parts every company. Both titles remember denial, and both repay it. Memory in heaven never blurs or bargains. What was denied together gets settled together. Settlement and sundering proceed without pause.

**From Announcement the Sūrah Moves Onward**

Courtroom rhythm governs this passage from wail to reply. Lament rose in verse 20, and heaven's answer fills verse 21. Titles have now been pronounced over all the prisoners. What remains is their handling in ordered stages. Muster, march, and questioning will follow in turn. Each stage will enact exactly what the titles announced. Judgment will settle accounts while Decision divides companies. The docket's momentum presses on every conscience. Nothing stalls, nothing appeals, nothing adjourns here. Momentum itself testifies that verdicts stand firm. Proceedings advance because outcomes were never doubtful. Doubt belonged to Makkah; certainty belongs to the Day. The court's calendar admits no postponements. What was dated before creation keeps its date. Punctuality in judgment mirrors punctuality in warning. Titles pronounced, the court proceeds to its next act, as the coming verse will show.
verses.22:
> ˹Allah will say to the angels,˺ “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers, and whatever they used to worship

**A Command to Angels Opens the Muster**

The court speaks, and angels move. *Uḥshurū* — Gather! — the imperative plural hurls heaven's marshals into action. Allah Himself issues the order; translators supply the speaker aloud, marking the help with brackets. No deliberation follows command in that court. Angels who recorded deeds now round up doers, and obedience that never wavered does not waver now. Muster begins the sentence's execution phase. Titles were pronounced in verse 21; bodies get collected in verse 22. Orderliness defines the operation from its first syllable. No fugitives slip away, no hiding places open, no delays intervene. The same precision that ranked angels in verse 1 now ranks prisoners. Command flows downward while captives flow inward. Heaven's chain of command has never broken and never will. What God orders assembled stands assembled before the echo fades. The muster is judgment's first footprint on the plain.

**Wrongdoers Covers Every Grade of Refusal**

*Ẓālimīn* — wrongdoers — casts the net deliberately wide. Wrongdoing in the Book centers on association: setting partners beside Allah wrongs both God and self. The Book names association the greatest wrongdoing of all (31:13). Early commentators debate the verse's precise scope with care. Some hear all wrongdoers of every kind and degree. Others narrow the referent to idolaters, since idols get gathered alongside. Still others hear all disbelievers in God generally. Each proposal draws its strength from the same context. The idols' presence favors the narrower readings, for the verse marches gods with devotees. Yet wrongdoing's breadth elsewhere warns against narrowing too far. The safer reading keeps disbelievers central while refusing to acquit fellow travelers. Scope matters because readers sort themselves by it. Everyone hopes the net catches others; the verse lets no wrongdoer hope. Breadth here is mercy to justice and menace to excuse.

**Peers Means Spouses, Kinds, and Companions at Once**

*Azwājahum* — their peers, their pairs — multiplies meaning fruitfully. Spouses first: idolatrous men and women gathered as households of error. Kinds second: each vice sorted with its own, deceivers with deceivers, tyrants with tyrants. Sects third: every creed of falsehood mustered under its own banner. Comrades fourth: the satans assigned to seducers in life (43:36). Polysemy here is not confusion but comprehensiveness. One word gathers households, professions, parties, and demons. Sorting by likeness displays justice's fine discrimination. Nobody gets misfiled, and nobody files an appeal. The peers share more than custody; they share the trait that condemned them: “you yourselves were a transgressing people” (37:30). Transgression was their common profession across every pairing. Pairs that sinned together stand together for sentencing. Association in guilt becomes association in gathering. Like seeks like, and judgment obliges the seeking.

**Idols Get Arrested Alongside Their Worshippers**

*Mā kānū yaʿbudūn* — whatever they used to worship — extends the arrest to gods. Idols of stone, saints misused, satans obeyed: all get rounded up. Helpless gods make the most eloquent exhibits. They cannot march themselves, so angels march them. They cannot speak, so their silence testifies. The Book elsewhere consigns worshipped falsehoods to fuel beside worshippers (21:98). Fuel and fire-starter arrive in one convoy. Shame compounds at every step of that march. Devotees watch their protectors dragged like scrap. Protectors watch devotees with whatever awareness remains to them. Mutual embarrassment previews mutual cursing. All alike converge where their roads always pointed: “they will ˹all˺ share in the punishment” (37:33). Sharing is the partnership's final honesty. Gods that could not save get saved from nothing. Exhibits need no defense attorneys. The convoy rolls toward its scheduled fire.

**The Verse Breaks Off Mid-Sentence by Design**

Grammar suspends the verse in mid-air. The sentence refuses to finish inside verse 22. Enjambment across the verse-break creates deliberate suspense. Mustering toward what destination? Marching under whose escort, and for how long? Questions hang unanswered for exactly one verse. Suspension is mercy's last literary gift to the narrative. Readers hold their breath with the prisoners. Breath held is attention paid. The coming line will spend what this line saves. Such pacing proves the sūrah's artistry serves its terror. Terror delayed by one verse lands heavier.
verses.23:
> instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell

**Instead of Allah Names the Crime in Passing**

*Min dūn Allāh* — instead of Allah, beside Him, beneath Him. Three English prepositions chase one Arabic exclusion. The phrase qualifies everything the wrongdoers worshipped. It also convicts everything in the same breath. Worship belongs to Allah the way light belongs to morning. Redirected worship is not alternative devotion but theft. The verse states the theft as settled fact. No argument rehearses why partners fail; failure arrives assumed. Brevity here is contempt for a refuted position. Idolatry has been answered since verse 4. *Instead* needs no elaboration after oneness was enthroned. A qualifier carries what volumes once argued. Compression rewards attentive readers of the whole sūrah. The crime's name is its sentence in miniature. Miniature sentences expand at the march's end. Expansion awaits its scheduled verse. Scheduling itself displays heaven's order.

**Guide Them Is Spoken With Heavy Irony**

*Ihdūhum* — guide them, lead them, show them the way. Guidance vocabulary marches prisoners toward fire. Irony this sharp cuts both directions. The guided get misguidance; the guides obey perfectly. Angels who guided believers with good news now guide deniers with chains. Same verb, opposite destinations, identical obedience. The Book elsewhere salts wounds with similar sweetness. *Good news* of torment greets persistent deniers (3:21). Tidings language delivers what warnings promised. Mockers taste their own medicine in grammar. They laughed at guidance; guidance now laughs last. Laughter from heaven is not cruelty but symmetry. Symmetry repays tone with tone, word with word. Ironic guidance guides infallibly — straight to Hell. Infallibility serves wrath as readily as mercy. Readiness of angels never varies with errand. Errands of wrath get wrath's punctuality. Punctuality in punishment mirrors punctuality in patience.

**The Path of Hell Gets Walked Step by Step**

*Ṣirāṭ al-jaḥīm* — the path of Hell, the road to ruin. Roads imply walking, and walking implies time. The condemned do not teleport to torment. They march, they trudge, they traverse under escort. Journey imagery stretches dread across distance. Each step rehearses arrival without delivering it. Muster promised this march: “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers” (37:22). Gathering completes; marching begins. Feet that strolled to idols now plod toward fire. Symmetry between road taken and road given holds exact. Earthly paths chose this path long ago. The road to Hell was paved by its walkers. Paving stones were choices, mortared with persistence. Walkers now walk what they built. Building was pleasure; walking is payment. Payment plans in hell admit no renegotiation. Renegotiation closed when revelation was mocked. Mockery mortared what persistence paved.

**Hell Has a Road Because Sinners Built One**

Moral geography underlies the verse's plain prose. Deeds are not only weighed; they are walked. Every sin laid one more stone on this road. Every mockery widened it for marching columns. The path pre-exists its walkers as tendency. Walkers actualize what tendency sketched. No one gets dragged down a stranger's road. Each company marches the highway its choices graded. Justice here is autobiographical to the last mile. Biographies written in deeds get read in footsteps. Footsteps echo choices back to choosers.

**Leading Includes the Idols in the Chain Gang**

*Them all* drags gods behind devotees in one file. The pronoun refuses to exempt the worshipped. Worshippers and worshipped march as a single convoy. Exhibits travel with the accused to court. Idols that never walked get carried or dragged. Carrying dead gods wearies living bearers usefully. Weariness preaches what worship denied. Gods as baggage: the image inverts all dunyā valuations. Valuations reverse wherever truth arrives. The convoy's terminus stands scheduled and certain: “return to ˹their place in˺ Hell” (37:68). Return implies belonging; Hell is called their place. Places keep what belongs to them. Belonging was chosen in markets and temples. Choosing ends; belonging begins. Beginnings in Hell never become endings. Endings belong to earthly roads alone. Alone with belonging, crowds learn permanence. Permanence is the path's final paving stone. Paving complete, walking continues forever.
verses.24:
> And detain them, for they must be questioned.”

**A Halt Is Ordered on the Road to Hell**

Marching columns freeze at a single verb. *Qifūhum* — stop them, detain them, hold them fast. Angels grip shoulders; the convoy shudders to stillness. Halts in heaven's procedures always mean business. This halt means interrogation before incineration. Prisoners taste suspense sharper than marching. Marching occupied feet; halting frees dread. Stillness amplifies every sound the heart makes. Hearts pound loud enough to accuse themselves. The road waits, the fire waits, the angels wait. Waiting is the overture questioning requires. Overtures in this court never play long. Brevity of pause concentrates its terror. Terror concentrated works faster than terror diffused. Diffusion belongs to earthly delays alone. Alone in stillness, multitudes hear heartbeats. Heartbeats drum the rhythm of reckoning. Reckoning approaches on silent feet. Silent feet halt loudest of all. Halts reveal what marches conceal. Concealment ends where questioning begins.

**Questioning Here Means Rebuke, Not Research**

*Masʾūlūn* — to be questioned, held to account. Heaven asks nothing to learn anything. Omniscience needs no depositions from the damned. Questioning therefore exposes rather than explores. Queries corner; answers condemn. The march led here for this purpose: “lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell” (37:23). Paths end in questioning before they end in fire. Interrogation dignifies the proceedings with due process. Due process observed will silence all appeals. Appeals require flaws, and heaven's process has none. Rebuke-questions need no true answers. Silence answers them; stammering answers them. Every response convicts, including none at all. Research seeks truth; rebuke displays it. Display is the trial's whole purpose. Purposes in heaven never miscarry. Miscarriage belongs to earthly justice alone. Alone before queries, crowds dissolve into defendants. Defendants without answers still supply verdicts. Verdicts extracted this way stand unshakeable.

**No Sinner Passes to Fire Unquestioned**

Universality governs the halt without exception. Every soul faces queries before flames. The Book swears this oath elsewhere plainly. By your Lord, all will be questioned about deeds (15:92–93). Oaths from heaven admit no loopholes. Loopholes belong to earthly evasions alone. Thoroughness defines divine reckoning throughout. No file stays unopened, no whisper unweighed. Weighing weighs motives alongside movements. Movements of limbs, motions of hearts. Hearts stand audited as strictly as hands. Strictness here is exactness wearing majesty. Majesty never bullies, but never blinks. Blinking would betray the victims of wrongdoing. Wrongdoing's victims deserve heaven's thoroughness. Thoroughness honors sufferers while terrifying oppressors. Oppressors preferred quick fires to slow queries. Queries prolong what flames would finish. Finishing delayed is dread compounded. Compounding works against defendants here. Defendants learn deliberation's dreadful pace.

**One Verse Says None Will Be Asked**

An apparent tension sharpens the doctrine. Another passage declares none questioned about sins that Day (55:39). Unasked there, questioned here — how do both stand? Exegetes reconcile the stations with care. Different stands host different procedures, most conclude. At one stand, guilt shows so plainly that queries insult it. Faces declare verdicts before mouths open. At another stand, rebuke-questions expose denials formally. Formality serves witnesses, not information. Alternatively, *asked* carries two senses across passages. Interrogation for facts differs from arraignment for rebuke. Facts need no asking; rebels need arraigning. Both readings preserve both verses intact. Preservation of all texts guides all interpretation. Interpretation harmonizes where hastiness contradicts. Contradiction is the hasty reader's mirage. Mirages vanish under lexicography's patient lens. Lenses of learning clarify seeming conflicts. Conflicts resolved deepen confidence in coherence. Coherence across passages crowns the Book's unity.
verses.25:
> ˹Then they will be asked,˺ “What is the matter with you that you can no longer help each other?”

**The Question Lands Where Boasts Once Stood**

Silence breaks at heaven's chosen instant. *Mā lakum* — what is the matter with you? Rebuke wears interrogation's clothing here. The halted column hears its first query. Queries in this court convict by echo. Echoes need no answers to condemn. Detention led to this moment precisely: “they must be questioned” (37:24). Questioning begins where marching paused. Pauses end; probes begin. Probes of heaven never miss. Missing belongs to earthly archers alone. Alone before the query, crowds stand exposed. Exposure precedes every confession. Confessions here arrive without remedy. Remedies expired when warnings were mocked. Mockery enjoyed its season; queries enjoy theirs. Seasons turn, and turns surprise only the heedless. Heedless crowds meet heedful interrogation. Interrogation proceeds with unhurried exactness. Exactness in queries mirrors exactness in records. Records kept faithfully get read relentlessly. Relentless reading leaves no boast standing.

**Mutual Help Was Their Proudest Earthly Claim**

*Tanāṣur* — mutual help, allied aid — anchored tribal pride. Tribes boasted numbers, patrons, and confederate gods. Numbers promised rescue in every dispute. Patrons promised intercession at every throne. Gods promised victory before every battle. Promises stacked upon promises built false confidence. Confidence untested feels identical to confidence true. Testing day distinguishes them forever. Alliances signed in dunyā get audited now. Audits expose what handshakes concealed. Concealment ends where consequence begins. Beginnings of judgment end endings of bluff. Bluff called is bluff collapsed. Collapse of allies precedes collapse of hope.

**The Question Answers Itself by Being Asked**

Rhetorical queries need no respondent. Asking *why no help?* displays *no help*. Display suffices; reply would gild ruin. Ruin ungilded shines brighter. Brighter shame burns deeper. Courts ask what all can see. Seeing answers before speaking begins. Beginnings of queries end all excuses. Excuses require plausible deniability. Deniability died at the Blast. Blasts end debates; queries bury them. Burials of argument need no mourners. Mourners for excuses never gather. Gathering happens only for sentencing now. Sentencing proceeds on rails of evidence. Evidence rails run straight and level. Level tracks admit no derailment. Derailment belongs to earthly trials alone. Alone on the rails, defendants ride silently. Silently riding, they reach scheduled ruin. Ruin scheduled keeps every appointment. Appointments in hell never get postponed. Postponement expired with earthly mornings. Mornings of mercy have all been spent.

**Helplessness Together Previews Blame Together**

Shared helplessness curdles fast into shared hatred. Allies unable to help soon accuse. Accusation follows impotence like thunder follows lightning. Lightning of queries splits alliances apart. Apart fall leaders, apart fall led. The sūrah will stage their quarrel ahead. Quarrels previewed here erupt there in full. Full fury needs no help to harm. Harm by words replaces help by deeds. Deeds of aid having failed, words of blame suffice. Sufficiency of blame surprises first-time damned. Disowning begins where rescue ended: “You disbelieved on your own.” (37:29). Own-ness of guilt gets stressed by deserters. Deserters of solidarity were its first betrayers. Betrayals rehearsed in life perform in death. Death reveals partnerships' hollow cores. Cores of alliance held only convenience. Convenience evaporates where consequence condenses. Condensation of consequence drowns excuses.

**Earthly Alliances Dissolve on Schedule**

Dissolution follows a timetable heaven keeps. The Book describes the pattern elsewhere plainly. Followed leaders disown following crowds, and ties snap (2:166–167). Snapping ties whip both ends. Ends of alliance bleed regret. Regret arrives precisely on schedule. Schedules of dissolution surprise only signatories. Signatories imagined perpetuity in parchment. Parchments of dunyā burn like straw. Straw alliances feed fires of regret. Fires lit by folly warm nobody. Nobody's warmth comes from burnt bonds. Bonds of falsehood bind only toward ruin. Ruin receives all its subscribers. Subscribers to error get billed in full. Full billing surprises installment-minded sinners. Sinners on credit meet collection day. Collection days favor no debtors. Debtors of deeds pay in person. Persons cannot delegate their balances. Balances personal, payments personal, ruin personal. Personal endings dissolve collective pretensions. Pretensions of parties perish with parties.
verses.26:
> In fact, on that Day they will be ˹fully˺ submissive

**Helplessness Gets Its Own Name: Submission**

The question of verse 25 gets its silent answer here. Asked why they cannot help each other — “no longer help each other” (37:25) — the deniers offer no defense. Instead they sink into *istislām*, utter submissiveness. *Bal hum yawmaʾidhin mustaslimūn*: nay, on that Day they are fully submissive. Submission names what helplessness only described. Helplessness was the fact; submission is the posture. Bodies that swaggered in markets now sag before the bench. The verse grants them no speech, only surrender. Silence that began in verse 21 hardens into submission here. Hardening completes what halting started. No ally speaks for them, and they cannot speak for themselves. Submission fills the vacuum that boasting vacated. Vacated thrones of pride seat humbled prisoners. The Day renames every denier with one word: submissive. Renaming by heaven overwrites every earthly title.

**Submission Here Is Surrender, Not Faith**

*Istislām* must not be mistaken for *islām*. Faith submits willingly before sight; surrender submits helplessly after it. The difference is timing, and timing is everything. Pharaoh supplies the archetype, believing only as waters closed over him (10:90–91). Waters accept no converts. Compulsion voids the very trust it produces. Heaven rewards certainty embraced in darkness, not certainty forced by dawn. Dawn has now broken over the plain of gathering. Submission at dawn confesses power without embracing mercy. Power confessed too late saves no one. The submissive remain sentenced; surrender changes posture, not verdict. Postures impress crowds, but verdicts answer to deeds. Distinguishing surrender from faith protects the doctrine of grace. Grace offered in markets cannot be claimed at musters. Claims require open doors, and doors stand shut. Shut doors teach the living to enter early.

**Fully Closes the Last Loophole of Defiance**

Translators render the totality as *fully*, and totality is the point. Submission here is not partial, feigned, or reserved. Bodies bow, tongues still, hearts collapse together. Outward surrender without inward defiance: the verse allows no remainder. Remainders of pride would be oases in the desert of doom. No oasis appears on this horizon. The promised humbling arrives in full: “you will be fully humbled” (37:18). Verse 18 threatened; verse 26 performs. Performance matches promise word for word. *Fully* in the threat becomes *fully* in the fact. Completeness of fulfillment mirrors completeness of warning. Warnings this exact leave defiance no vocabulary. Total submission answers total rebellion. Rebellion totaled across lifetimes meets surrender totaled in a moment. Moments of surrender cannot repay years of scorn. Scorn spent freely; submission spends itself freely too.

**In Fact Corrects Every Illusion of Resistance**

*Bal* strikes again, heaven's eraser of false impressions. The particle cancels whatever resistance readers might imagine. Perhaps the deniers will fight, argue, or flee? *Bal* — nay — they will do none of these. Correction arrives before illusion can settle. Settling illusions harden into false hopes. False hopes in hell are their own torment. The verse preempts torment's appetizer with truth's flat statement. Flat statements from heaven flatten all resistance. Resistance imagined dissolves at *bal*. *Bal* in verse 12 introduced wonder; here it introduces surrender.

**Submission Without Intercessors Completes the Isolation**

No idol stands beside its devotees now. No patron pleads, no kinsman intervenes, no son ransoms. Intercession's whole marketplace has closed for them. Submission in company might comfort; submission alone desolates. Desolation is the verse's unspoken atmosphere. Each submissive soul kneels in solitary custody. Solitude among multitudes sharpens every sting. Multitudes surround, yet none assists. Assistance was the question of verse 25. Submission is the answer of verse 26. Question and answer share one word: alone. Alone they boasted, alone they cower. Cowering completes what boasting began. Beginnings in pride end in prostration of despair. Despair prostrates without worshipping. Worship requires hope, and hope has fled. Flight of hope leaves submission hollow. Hollow submission still bows the back. Backs bow while hearts break silently.
verses.27:
> They will turn on each other, throwing blame

**Submission Explodes Into Mutual Accusation**

Surrender to God curdles into warfare with fellows. *Aqbalū ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāʾalūn*: they turn on each other, questioning. Turning here means confronting, not conversing. The submissive of the previous verse — “they will be ˹fully˺ submissive” (37:26) — find sideways targets. Submission upward, accusation sideways: the verse pivots between postures. Pivots this sharp snap old alliances. Alliances snapped become weapons in hand. Hands that clasped in dunyā now point in accusation. Pointing fingers multiply faster than helping hands ever did. Multiplication of blame divides every partnership. Partnerships of error end in courts of recrimination. Recrimination needs no judge to wound. Wounds of words precede wounds of fire. Fire awaits the quarrel's inconclusive end. Ends inconclusive still conclude with flames. Flames settle what quarrels cannot.

**Questioning Here Means Blaming, Not Learning**

*Yatasāʾalūn* — they question one another — sounds almost scholarly. Scholarship ends at the verb's tone. Tone here is cross-examination without a judge. No one seeks information; everyone assigns fault. Fault flies in both directions at once. Contrast dignifies the same verb elsewhere. In gardens ahead, the saved also turn toward one another — “turn to one another inquisitively” (37:50). Inquisitiveness there savors joy; interrogation here savors gall. Same verb, opposite eternities. Company in bliss converses; company in ruin accuses. Accusation is fellowship inverted by fire. Inversion completes what perversion began. Beginnings in flattery end in litigation. Litigation without counsel convicts all parties. Parties to error become parties to suits. Suits without judges end without acquittals. Acquittals require innocence, and none remains. Remnants of affection dissolve in accusation.

**Alliances of Error End in Courts of Blame**

Every false alliance carries its dissolution inside it. Dissolution day arrives with the questioning. The Book exhibits the pattern in earlier nations. Communities entering fire curse the communities before them (7:38–39). Curses between predecessors and successors fill that passage. Each community begs double torment for its seducers. Begging changes nothing; sharing remains the sentence. Patterns repeat because human nature repeats. Nature unenlightened befriends, then betrays, then blames. Betrayal follows befriending as night follows day. Dawns in hell bring no light. Light belongs to another company entirely. Entirely abandoned, alliances accuse themselves. Self-accusation of alliances never ends. Ends of error never arrive. Arrival of justice surprises only fools. Fools befriend what the wise fear. Fear of company misplaced damns multitudes. Multitudes in error share single fates.

**Turning Physicalizes a Spiritual Collapse**

*Aqbala ʿalā* — to turn toward — moves bodies into enmity. Faces swing around; eyes lock; fingers rise. Choreography of quarrel needs no rehearsal. Rehearsals happened across lifetimes of friction. Friction of interests now ignites openly. Open enmity replaces covert rivalry. Rivalry of leaders and led surfaces at last. Surfacing drowns whatever politeness remained. Politeness of dunyā was camouflage. Camouflage burns quickly in hell's approach. Approaches of fire strip all pretense. Pretense stripped, hatred stands naked. Naked hatred needs no translation. Translations belong to ambiguous gestures.

**Blame Shares Nothing and Changes Nothing**

Quarrels imply stakes worth contesting. No stakes remain contestable here. Blame redistributes nothing; punishment stays pooled. Pooling is the sentence: “share in the punishment” (37:33). Shares in fire cannot be shorted or hedged. Hedging belongs to earthly markets. Markets of excuse have closed forever. Forever is the market's new closure. Closures final admit no appeal. Appeals would need innocence to plead. Pleading requires counsel, and none appears. Appearances of justice deceive no one here. Here only consequence keeps accounts. Accounts balanced in fire never reopen. Reopening requires error, and none occurred. Occurrences in court stand forever accurate. Accuracy of heaven needs no audit. Audits of angels embarrass only doubters. Doubters of justice watch it executed. Execution of sentence ends all litigation. Litigation's end leaves only lamentation. Lamentations unheard fill eternity.
verses.28:
> The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”

**The Followers Speak First, and They Point Upward**

Blame takes the stand in follower's dress. The misled open the quarrel's proceedings. Opening speeches set the quarrel's terms. Terms here accuse upward, never inward. Upward fingers point at thrones of influence. Influence in dunyā becomes liability in fire. Liability assigned, the accusers rest their case. Cases built on blame need defendants. Defendants sit enthroned in the same flames. Flames make equals of accusers and accused. Equals in fire quarrel over ranks of guilt. Ranks of guilt matter to the guilty. Guilty quarrels fill this verse: “throwing blame” (37:27). Blame thrown returns as blame shared. Shared blame burns no cooler. Cooler heads never enter this court. Courts of fire specialize in heat. Heat of quarrel preheats hell's chambers.

**From the Right Means From the Side of Power**

Arabic says the chiefs came *from the right*. *ʿAn al-yamīn*: from the right hand, the side of strength. Right hands seal oaths and wield swords. Chiefs approached with oaths and swords both. Promises allured; threats compelled. Translation renders the idiom as delusion from right guidance. Rendering interprets; interpretation here clarifies truly. Coming from the right meant coming as trusted counselors. Counselors of falsehood wore truth's wardrobe. Wardrobes of piety disguised wolves effectively. Wolves in wardrobes mislead sheep systematically. Sheep accuse shepherds when wolves arrive undisguised. Undisguised ruin ends all masquerades. Masquerades of dunyā dissolve at graves. Graves strip costumes from counselors. Counselors exposed face their counseled. Counseled crowds confront unmasked liars. Liars unmasked still lie about lying. Lying about lying doubles the guilt.

**You Deluded Us Pleads Seduction as Excuse**

*Aḍlaltumūnā* — you deluded us, you led us astray. Accusation doubles as exoneration plea. Pleas of seduction have ancient precedent. Adam blamed Eve; Eve blamed the serpent. Serpents get blamed; blamers still fall. Falling follows listening, whatever the voices. Voices of chiefs sounded sweet and sure. Sweetness of tone never licensed obedience. Obedience to creatures ends where disobedience to God begins. Beginnings of compromise end in pits. Pits receive seduced and seducers together. Togetherness in pits consoles no one. No seduction excuses surrendered reason. Reason surrendered answers for itself. Itself stands judged, not its seducers only. Seducers only share the dock, not the verdict's cause. Causes of ruin include invitations accepted. Accepted invitations bind acceptors eternally. Eternally bound, excuse-seekers find no exit. Exits from fire open for no one.

**What Is Right Was Never Hidden From Them**

*Ḥaqq* — the right, the true, the real — stood public. Messengers proclaimed it in every marketplace. Marketplaces heard; markets chose otherwise. Choices, not chances, damned the choosers. Choosers of falsehood now blame its salesmen. Salesmen of error advertised openly. Open advertisements deceive only willing buyers. Buyers of falsehood inspected the goods. Goods glittering with dunyā's glare blinded them. Blinding was voluntary throughout. Voluntary blindness pleads no mitigation. Mitigation requires ignorance, and knowledge abounded. Abundance of warning drowns excuses finally. Finally the weak confront the mighty in fire (40:47–48). Fires of confrontation illuminate old choices. Choices illuminated accuse choosers clearly. Clearly seeing, late seers weep vainly. Vain weeping waters no mercy. Mercies dried up with earthly mornings. Mornings of warning set forever. Forever the weak wish they had listened. Listening refused becomes wailing required.
verses.29:
> The misleaders will reply, “No! You disbelieved on your own

**Denial Meets Denial: No Opens the Defense**

Chiefs answer charges with a slammed door. *Lā* — No! — the whole defense in one syllable. Syllables of denial match syllables of accusation. Accusation claimed delusion: “deluded us away from what is right” (37:28). Delusion alleged, delusion denied. Denied delusion still damned its deniers. Deniers of misleading stand convicted of it. Convictions precede confessions in this court. Courts of heaven convict before quarrels conclude. Conclusions of quarrels change no verdicts. Verdicts fixed before speeches began. Beginnings of blame end in shared fire. Fires shared warm no disputants. Disputants burn while denying together. Togetherness in denial mirrors togetherness in error. Errors together, denials together, fires together. Togetherness completes what solitude began. Began in markets, completed in flames. Flames complete every incomplete confession. Confessions incomplete still incriminate fully.

**On Your Own Returns Responsibility to Senders**

*Kuntum* — you were, yourselves — redirects every finger. Fingers pointed upward swing back downward. Downward they indicate willing breasts. Breasts that welcomed falsehood willingly. Willingness voids victimhood entirely. Victimhood requires coercion, and none occurred. Coercion absent, choice convicts. Choices of followers matched invitations of chiefs. Chiefs invited; followers RSVP'd with enthusiasm. Enthusiasm for error embarrasses excuses now. Excuses of compulsion collapse unbuilt. Unbuilt defenses shelter no defendants. Defendants of delusion stand self-condemned. Self-condemnation needs no prosecution. Prosecutions proceed regardless, for records demand it. Demands of records exceed needs of proof. Proofs abound where excuses evaporate. Evaporations of excuse leave guilt crystallized. Crystallized guilt refracts no mercy. Mercies refracted nowhere reach no one. No one reaches mercy through blame. Blame navigates nowhere but deeper fire. Fires deeper await blamers and blamed. Blamed and blaming burn side by side.

**The Defense Is Half True and Fully Insufficient**

Followers were willing; the defense states facts. Facts partial make defenses porous. Porous defenses leak under questioning. Questioning exposes omitted halves efficiently. Halves omitted include invitations issued. Issued invitations bear inviters' guilt. Guilt of inviters persists alongside guests'. Guests came willingly; hosts invited eagerly. Eagerness both ways doubles the damnation. Damnations doubled still burn singly. Singly each soul answers despite doubling. Doubling of guilt halves no sentence. Sentences full fall on partial pleaders. Pleaders of halves hear wholes in reply. Replies whole crush partial defenses. Defenses partial persuade no judges.

**Chiefs Plead What Satan Will Plead**

Templates of evasion repeat across the damned. Satan himself will plead identically. Identically? Nearly: no authority, only invitation (14:22). Invitations accepted bind acceptors, pleads the devil. Devil's logic mirrors chiefs' logic exactly. Exactly parallel evasions damn parallel evaders. Evaders of responsibility meet inescapable reckoning. Reckonings inescapable terrify evaders most. Most evasive argue most vainly. Vainly pleaded, paradigmatic excuses fail. Failures of Satan foreshadow failures of chiefs. Chiefs echoing Satan share Satan's dock. Docks crowded with echoes amplify wailing. Wailing amplified fills the fire's acoustics. Acoustics of hell carry every excuse nowhere. Nowhere-bound excuses travel eternally. Eternally traveling, never arriving at acquittal. Acquittals never greet the guilty. Guilty pleaders plead to empty benches. Benches empty of mercy seat justice only. Justice only, mercy elsewhere, pity none. None pities pleaders who pitied none.

**Doom Shared Gets Admitted Alongside Blame Refused**

Chiefs confess what they cannot contest. Contests over blame exclude contests over doom. Doom stands admitted by all parties: “we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺” (37:31). Tasting certain needs no taster's consent. Consent irrelevant, consequence proceeds. Proceedings of doom pause for no pleas. Pleas about causes ignore effects decreed. Decreed effects execute themselves. Themselves executing, sentences need no bailiffs. Bailiffs of heaven watch otiose. Otiose observers witness automatic justice. Automatic does not mean unruled. Unruled never describes heaven's order. Orders of doom derive from decrees. Decrees of God govern every tasting. Tastings governed proceed on schedule. Schedules of torment never slip. Slips belong to earthly kitchens. Kitchens of hell serve punctually. Punctual servings sicken eternally. Eternally sickened, tasters taste on. Tasting continues; lessening never comes. No lessening, no ending. Endings absent, tastings abide.
verses.30:
> We had no authority over you. In fact, you yourselves were a transgressing people

**No Authority Means No Compulsion, Not No Influence**

*Sulṭān* — authority, warrant, coercive proof — anchors the defense. Chiefs claim they wielded none over followers. Claims of impotence plead innocence by weakness. Weakness alleged, wickedness denied. Denied wickedness persists in records. Records show invitations, beautifications, threats. Threats unbacked by force still frightened. Frightened followers complied without chains. Chains absent, choices remained. Remaining choices condemn choosers. Choosers choosing error own outcomes. Outcomes owned cannot be disowned. Disowning attempted fails before facts. The denial this grounds was spoken just before: “You disbelieved on your own.” (37:29). Own-ness stressed, shared-ness suppressed. Suppressed sharing surfaces at sentencing. Sentencings surface all suppressions. Suppressions surface; surprises vanish. Vanish surprises; verdicts remain. Remainders of pleas dissolve. Dissolutions of defense delight justice. Justice delighted proceeds unimpeded. Unimpeded proceedings conclude swiftly. Swift conclusions stun slow pleaders.

**Satan's Speech Supplies the Template**

Chiefs plagiarize hell's oldest defendant. Satan's acquittal speech survives in the Book. No authority had I, he pleads, save calling (14:22). Calling voice, coming feet: responsibility stays with comers. Comers blame callers vainly. Vain blaming echoes through fire. Fires of hell amplify ancient excuses. Excuses ancient fail freshly. Fresh failures repeat old patterns. Patterns of evasion never evolve. Evolutions absent, repetitions reign. Reigns of repetition bore no one. Boredom absent, terror present. Present terrors teach timeless lessons. Lessons timeless: blame yourselves, not me. Me-blaming fails; self-blaming saves none either. Either way, fire receives both. Both caller and comer burn. Burning together, blaming apart. Apart in blame, together in flame. Flames together seal fates apart. Fates apart in degree, together in kind. Kinds of torment vary; fact remains. Remainders of excuse perish.

**Influence Without Force Still Earns the Fire**

Compulsion's absence never equaled innocence. Innocence requires clean hands, not weak ones. Hands of chiefs beckoned generations astray. Astray beckoned, multitudes followed. Followed beckonings bind beckoners. Beckoners bear double burdens. Burdens doubled: own error plus others'. Others' burdens pile on inviters (29:13). Inviters of error inherit followers' weight. Weights inherited crush preachers of falsehood. Falsehoods preached profit nothing. Nothings profited, torments multiplied. Multiplied torments match multiplied victims. Eloquence of error damns the eloquent. Eloquent damned outsuffer silent sinners. Sinners silent burn for selves alone. Alone-burning beats burden-bearing. Bearing others' burdens breaks chiefs. Chiefs broken beggar description. Descriptions beggared, fires suffice. Sufficient fires need no adjectives. Adjectives absent, agonies present. Heeders absent from warnings attend fires. Fires attended instruct eternally. Eternally instructed, never released.

**In Fact Corrects the Followers' Self-Portrait**

*Bal* returns to revise sympathies. Sympathies for followers seemed natural. Natural sympathies misread the scene. Scenes of shared guilt permit none. Nones of pity greet volunteers. Volunteers for error chose openly. Openly choosing, secretly regretting. Regretting secretly saves nothing. Nothings saved, all sentenced. Sentenced volunteers join volunteering chiefs. Chiefs volunteering invitations meet volunteers accepting. Accepting volunteers complete the circuit. Circuits complete conduct fire. Fires conducted burn circuits. Circuits burning, sympathies wither. Withered sympathies feed no appeals. Appeals unfed starve quickly. Quickly starved, hopes die. Dies hope, lives horror. Horrors living outlast hopes dead. Dead hopes bury living rebels. Rebels buried burn on. Burnings on, endings none. Nones of ending, alls of ache. Aches of all fill fire. Fires filled, quarrels proceed. Proceedings proceed; pity pauses.
verses.31:
> The decree of our Lord has come to pass against us ˹all˺: we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺

**Our Lord Confesses What Their Lips Long Denied**

*Rabbinā* — our Lord — slips from deniers' lips. Lips that denied lordship now own it. Owned lordship confessed too late. Lateness voids the confession's value. Values of faith expire at sight. Sights of doom compel admissions. Admissions compelled convince no courts. Courts of heaven weigh timing. Timings late forfeit mercies. Mercies forfeited return never. Nevers of mercy last forever. Forevers of loss begin here. Beginnings of loss end hopes. Hopes ended leave only tasting. Tastings certain await confessors. Dooms certain admit no delay. Delays expired with earthly dawns. Dawns earthly set forever. Forevers begun never end. Endings absent, pains persist. Persists pain, perishes pride. Prides perished confess truly. Truly confessed, still damned.

**Against Us All Levels Leaders and Led**

*ʿAlaynā* — against us — gathers every party. Parties to quarrel share single prepositions. Prepositions of doom admit no exceptions. Exceptions expired with excuses. Excuses expired, equality reigns. Reigns of equality level hierarchies. Hierarchies leveled: chiefs beside crowds. All againsted by a single decree. Decrees single cover multitudes. Multitudes covered confess together. Together confessing, the old defense dies: “We had no authority over you” (37:30). Authority denied, doom admitted. Admitted doom ends denials. Denials ended, fires near. Nearing fires silence boasts. Boasts silenced, truths spoken. Truth spoken damns speakers. Speakers damned fall silent. Silences final precede flames. Flames final finish quarrels. Quarrels finished, tastings start. Starts of tasting never stop. Stoppings none, tastings ever. Evers of tasting exhaust never.

**The Punishment Needs No Adjective Here**

*Al-ʿadhāb* — the punishment, known, definite. Definiteness assumes familiarity. Familiar punishments frighten most. Most-frightening: threats long heard. Heard threats materialize. Materialized threats terrify fulfilled. Fulfilled terrors exceed imaginings. Imaginings exceeded, horrors reign. Reigns of horror need no adjectives. Adjectives absent; articles suffice. Sufficiencies of *the* condemn fully. Fully condemned by two letters. Letters of definiteness seal doom. Dooms sealed open never. Forevers sealed admit no visitors. Visitors none; residents eternal. Residents eternal know the punishment. Known punishments punish knowingly. Knowing punishments fit knowers. Knowers fitted suffer precisely. Precise sufferings satisfy justice. Justice satisfied rests never. Rests never taken in fire. Fires restless burn residents. Residents burning know fully. Fully known, fully tasted. Tastings of the known torment. Torments known exceed unknown.

**Confession Completes the Leaders' Arc**

Leaders denied, excused, now confess. Confessions final end performances. Performances ended: denials, excuses, evasions. Evasions ended, truths emerge. Emerging truths damn their speakers. Speakers damned by honesty. Honesties late save none. Nones saved by timing's miss. Misses of timing prove fatal. Fatal misses recur as warnings. Warnings to leaders living now. Living leaders may confess early. Early confessions open mercies. Mercies opened await entrants. Entrants entering find welcome. Welcomes warm greet penitents. Penitents greeted gain pardon. Pardons gained erase dooms. Dooms erased, fates rewritten. Rewritten fates favor the early. Early favored, late condemned. Condemned late confess vainly. Vain confessions echo: “You disbelieved on your own.” (37:29). Own-ness once flung returns. Returns of denials boomerang. Boomeranged blame strikes blamers. Blamers struck confess jointly. Joint confessions close arcs.
verses.32:
> We caused you to deviate, for we ourselves were deviant.”

**Caused to Deviate Confesses the Crime**

*Aghwaynākum* — We caused you to deviate. Misled-yous confess misleading. Misleadings confessed damn confessors. Confessors damned speak truly. Truly spoken, truly damning. Damning truths need no polish. Polishes absent, guilt gleams. Gleaming guilt blinds pleaders. Blinded pleaders stumble sentenced. Sentenced stumblers fall flaming. Flaming falls finish quarrels. Finished quarrels yield tastings, as the leaders confess: “we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺” (37:31). Tastings yielded last forever. Forevers yielded never return. Returns never granted in fire. Fires grant no returns. Returns refused, regrets retained. Retained regrets torment tasters. Tasters tormented taste on. Tastings on, pleadings off. Pleadings off, pains on. Pains on, hopes off. Hopes off, horrors on. Horrors on, mercies off. Mercies off forevermore. Forevermores of loss begin. Begun losses never end. Ended never, pains persist. Persists pain, perishes plea. Pleas perished leave silence. Silences of guilt deafen. Deafened heavens hear none.

**The Charge Returns as Confession**

Followers charged delusion earlier. Earlier charges echo now. Echoings of charges convict. Convicted chargers confess charges. Charges confessed: delusion admitted. Admitted delusions damn admitters. Admitters damned speak the charge itself: “deluded us away from what is right” (37:28). Rights abandoned, wrongs embraced. Embraced wrongs strangle embracers. Embracers strangled gasp guilty. Guilty gasps convince none. Nones convinced hear more. Mores of confession continue. Continued confessions compound guilt. Guilts compounded crush confessors. Crushed confessors confess more. Mores of guilt emerge. Emergings of guilt glare. Glarings of guilt blind. Blinded by guilt, chiefs babble. Babblings of chiefs damn crowds. Crowds damned curse chiefs. Chiefs cursed curse back. Back-cursings fill fires. Fires filled with cursings. Cursings filling fires fuel flames. Flames fueled burn cursers. Cursers burning curse on. Cursings on, blessings none. Blessings none ever enter. Enters never mercy here. Heres of horror last.

**For We Ourselves Were Deviant Explains Without Excusing**

*Ghāwīn* — deviant, erring, lost. Lost leaders led multitudes astray. Astray-multitudes follow astray-chiefs. Astray chiefs plead their straying. Strayings pleaded explain nothing. Nothings explained excuse none. Nones excused by causes. Causes cited condemn citers. Citers condemned cite more. Mores cited damn deeper. Deeper damnings need no causes. Causes needless, guilt remains. Remainings of guilt persist. Persists guilt, perishes excuse. Excuses perished plead never. Nevers of excuse last. Compounded losses crush. Crushed by loss, chiefs confess. Confessings of chiefs continue. Continuings of confession weary none. Weariless confessions damn doubly.

**Stray Guides Lead Convoys Over Cliffs**

Guides astray guide astray. Astray-guidings doom convoys. Convoys doomed follow blindly. Blind followers fall off cliffs. Cliffs of error await. Awaitings of cliffs certain. Certain ruins approach. Approachings of ruin hasten. Hastenings of doom quicken. Quickenings of fire near. Nearings of flame terrify. Terrifying flames precede tastings. Doubly terrified, convoys confess. Continuings of confession compound. Compoundings of guilt crush. Crushings of guilt powder. Powdered guilt chokes. Chokings of powder blind. Blindings of powder darken. Darkenings of doom deepen. Deepenings of darkness last. Lastings of darkness never lift. Liftings never granted. Mercies never granted return. Standings of refusal last. Lastings of refusal harden. Hardenings of refusal petrify. Petrified refusals mock pleadings. Pleadings mocked fall silent. Silences mocked damn deeper. Burdens of the misled pile on misleaders (16:25).

**Confession Without Repentance Seals the File**

*Iqrār* admits; *tawbah* returns. Returns absent, admissions damn. Damnings of admission last. Hardenings of file seal. Sealings of file final. Finals of sealing stand. Lastings of seals never break. Breakings never granted seals. Holdings of seals harden. Damned by files, chiefs burn. Burnings of files light. Lightings of files glare. Files never lifted stand. Standings of files accuse. Accusings of files convict. Convictings of files conclude. Damned by conclusions, all burn. Blind by glare, none escape. Escapes none granted ever. Evers of denial end.
verses.33:
